note: Family-run in-town RV park off Live Oak Blvd, a few blocks from downtown Yuba City, shaded by mature trees. Mostly long-term: about 5 of its 44 sites are sold online by the night, and long-term guests are screened. --Claude
summary: Travelhome Park (Yuba City): DROP CANDIDATE - $60/night on its own engine (Dec 2026 and Mar 2027, +8% service fee), no gateway within 40 km, not a Good Sam Park; Google 3.4 (40 reviews) is under the 4.0/25-review line; mostly long-term (5 of 44 sites bookable online, 2-night online minimum).
